findings.title: GIT.TRAILER's doctor-table severity contradicts the deliberately-implemented code
findings.description: The doctor check table documents GIT.TRAILER as failing with severity WARN ('last 20 commits carry the versionless trailer | otherwise (WARN)'), but src/CLI/Doctor.jl implements it as a hard FAIL and says so on purpose: line 553 carries the comment '# a FAIL, not a WARN: RULE.GIT.TRAILER is a rule, and a check that cannot fail is not a check', and line 554 calls fail(...), never warn(...), when a commit lacks the trailer. Every other genuinely-WARN row in the same table (ROUND.OPEN, ROUND.ABANDONED, ROUND.DEV, CFG.TERRITORIES, LEG.SENTINELS's fuzzy-match case) matches its check function's warn(...) call exactly; only GIT.TRAILER's table entry disagrees with its check function, against an explicit design comment — meaning the documentation, not the code, has drifted.
findings.resolution_hint: Change the doctor-table row for GIT.TRAILER in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:1889 to drop the '(WARN)' annotation (or state FAIL, matching the undecorated rows in the table), so it agrees with Doctor.jl:549-554's deliberate FAIL.

findings.title: AUDIT.GAP's doctor-table description names the wrong field (head instead of closed_head)
findings.description: The doctor check table states AUDIT.GAP fails when 'every closed audit round's base equals the previous closed audit's head' does not hold. But src/CLI/Doctor.jl:624 actually compares the next round's base against the PREVIOUS round's closed_head field, falling back to head only when closed_head is absent: get(audits[i-1].round, "closed_head", audits[i-1].round["head"]). Per the ROUND.toml field list given earlier in this same document (line 1441-1442), head is the round's OPENING head and closed_head is a distinct field recorded at close — so for any round with fix passes between open and close, head and closed_head differ, and the doc's stated comparison target is the wrong one for the code's actual (and more correct) continuity check.
findings.resolution_hint: Update the AUDIT.GAP row to say the comparison is against the previous closed audit's closed_head (falling back to head when closed_head is absent), matching src/CLI/Doctor.jl:624.
